title: LA City General Fund postings, September 2025 vs September 2024

attempts.text: The General Fund postings for September 2025 were $822.4 million, which was $0.2% lower than the $823.7 million posted in September 2024. The decrease in postings is attributed to a 0.2% increase in Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration and a 100.0% increase in Fire. The year-to-date postings through September 2025 were $2.12 billion, which was $0.3% higher than the $2.12 billion posted in September 2024.

final_text: General Fund postings were $822.4m in September 2025, down 0.2% from $823.7m in September 2024. Year-to-date postings were $2.12bn, up 0.3%. The largest movements were: Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration decreased by $65.4m; Fire increased by $37.0m; Non-Departmental - Water and Electricity increased by $7.4m.
